column1: # The script module variables (src/game/Script/ModVarTable.c, every level's module under one name): Module.name,
# tag, why. Tags: WORLD (one value for the world), PLAYER (one value per player: an overlay of ModVars.c in stage
# 1.2), PARTY (one value per party: the coop party, the acting player outside coop), PLAYER_SHARED and PARTY_SHARED
# (state of one player or party whose flow still runs in the world's context of a machine, an NPC, a race or a scene:
# one shared value as before until a later stage gives the flow its player, then PLAYER or PARTY), CLIENT (a client's
# own menu or view state). netclass.py counts the rows without a tag.
